body.message:
As per your request, please find below the monthly rates for a 1-Bedroom Apartment at Central Park at City Walk (Viridian 1) for a 6-month stay:

September: AED 8,000
October: AED 8,500
November: AED 9,500
December: AED 10,000
January: AED 9,500
February: AED 9,500

Please note that a refundable security deposit of AED 2,000 is required.

Kindly note that the booking will be processed on a monthly basis only (30 nights per month).

To confirm and secure either a 3-month or 6-month booking, payment of the first month's rent, last month's rent, and the security deposit is required in advance. Once the payment has been received, we will reserve the unit and guarantee the agreed rates for the confirmed booking period.

Should you wish to proceed, please let us know, and we will be happy to assist you with the booking process.

Thank you.
